visual.detailed_description: Patient 1, Patient 2, Patient 3, Patient 4 headings precede separate blue/gray horizontal event timelines. panels.general_description: Composite figure with four vertically stacked patient-labeled timelines and a lower polysomnography waveform screenshot.
panels.detailed_description: Timeline headed Patient 1: A horizontal blue/gray arrow timeline is headed by literal Patient 1. Stroke is labeled at the left. Printed month markers run along early chevrons, with event labels connected by oblique leader lines. PSG: 2 months; PFO Closure: 3 months; CPAP started: 4 months; Initial CPAP follow-up: 5 months; No recurrence of stroke: 24 months. The long terminal arrow is not drawn as a demonstrably uniform linear time scale. Timeline headed Patient 2: A horizontal blue/gray arrow timeline is headed by literal Patient 2. Stroke is labeled at the left. Printed month markers run along early chevrons, with event labels connected by oblique leader lines. PFO Closure: 4 months; HST,CPAP started: 5 months; Initial CPAP follow-up: 6 months; No recurrence of stroke: 24 months. The long terminal arrow is not drawn as a demonstrably uniform linear time scale. Timeline headed Patient 3: A horizontal blue/gray arrow timeline is headed by literal Patient 3. Stroke is labeled at the left. Printed month markers run along early chevrons, with event labels connected by oblique leader lines. PSG: 4 months; CPAP started: 5 months; Initial CPAP follow-up: 6 months; No recurrence of stroke: 15 years. The long terminal arrow is not drawn as a demonstrably uniform linear time scale. Timeline headed Patient 4: A horizontal blue/gray arrow timeline is headed by literal Patient 4. Stroke is labeled at the left. Printed month markers run along early chevrons, with event labels connected by oblique leader lines. PSG: 2 months; CPAP started: 4 months; Initial CPAP follow-up: 5 months; No recurrence of stroke: 12 months. The long terminal arrow is not drawn as a demonstrably uniform linear time scale. Bottom unlabelled polysomnography strip (caption: p4): Below the four timelines is a dense multichannel waveform screenshot on a white/light grid. Stacked black traces occupy upper rows, blue traces cross the middle-upper portion, and red/pink/purple/green traces appear in lower rows. Left-edge channel labels and small event annotation boxes are present; near the right edge several upper traces show a brief larger deflection. Labels include EEG/EOG-style derivations and respiratory/cardiovascular rows, but small numeric event values are not reliably readable at the native image size. No precise HR, saturation minima, apnea duration, scale calibration or sampling rate is transcribed from this strip.

visual.general_description: Background proposed mechanism flowchart linking OSA/PFO to stroke risk.
visual.detailed_description: A black-and-white flowchart on white background has a top rectangular box labeled Obstructive sleep apnea, a left box labeled Patent foramen ovale(PFO), and a bottom box labeled Increased risk of cryptogenic stroke. Solid arrows connect text nodes through O2desaturation/hypoxemia, pulmonary artery vasoconstriction, negative intrathoracic pressure and increased right atrial pressure to right-to-left shunting and paradoxical embolization. Other branches pass through autonomic dysfunction, atrial cardiopathy, hypercoagulable state and atrial thrombus. Connecting paths join above the bottom boxed stroke-risk endpoint. No patient labels, measurements, scales or clinical test results appear.
